name: Melita
line: Melita, now called Malta, is the Mediterranean island where Paul and his shipmates came safely ashore after the shipwreck on their way to Rome.

moments.title: Safe on shore
moments.text: Everyone from the ship reached land safely and learned the island was called Malta. The islanders showed extraordinary kindness and built a fire because it was cold and rainy.

moments.title: The viper
moments.text: A viper fastened itself to Paul's hand as he laid sticks on the fire. Paul shook it off and was not harmed, so the islanders changed their minds and said he was a god.

moments.title: Welcomed by Publius
moments.text: Publius, the chief official of the island, had an estate nearby. He welcomed Paul and his companions and treated them kindly for three days.
